_comment: Slot 3 of a reading: when the angle peaks, by transiting body.
Keyed body, then direction: [0] is applying, still coming to exact,
[1] is separating, already past it. Three variants of each.
A day's nine cards are mostly driven by whichever body is moving
fastest, so several of them share a transit body and a direction. With
one clause per state, four cards a morning ended on the same sentence,
which is the single most visible way an assembled page gives itself
away. reading.js walks this list rather than seeding it, so two cards
on one day cannot land on the same clause.
Every entry begins with a back-reference or a time word. 'It' is the
aspect slot 1 described; none of these may introduce a subject. And
none of them names a body, because the card prints that from the chart.
